Q436.reason: Permissive intervention under Rule 24(b) is available because the employer's property claim shares common questions of law and fact with the clerk's negligence claim, and the court has discretion over delay and prejudice.

Q434.reason: Under UCC 2-209(2) the signed written-modification clause bars the oral May 1 price increase, and any waiver argument under 2-209(4) is weak here.

Q441.reason: Reputation for poor driving is character evidence offered to prove negligent conduct on one occasion, which FRE 404 and 405 generally bar in an ordinary negligence case; the DUI plea is also likely excluded, but it is a closer call.
